question: A rider who uses a wheelchair travels this weekend from 59 St-Columbus Circle to 23 St-Baruch College using only the services and free transfers shown on this map. Walking between stations joined on the map counts as a transfer, and the trip ends when a train arrives at 23 St-Baruch College itself. They can only enter, leave or change trains at stations marked with the accessibility symbol. They want the fewest transfers and, among those trips, the fewest station stops. Which services do they ride, in order? If more than one service runs between the same two stations on a leg, any of them is accepted.
